games.2026_04_PIT_CLE: Two below-average AFC North teams on a short week, with rain likely arriving during the game. Pittsburgh is without Rico Dowdle and Brandin Echols (both doubtful) and has Jalen Ramsey in a sling; Cleveland's center Elgton Jenkins is doubtful with a concussion, Teven Jenkins is out again, and Tytus Howard and Tyson Campbell are questionable. Neither quarterback grades as an edge. The model has the Steelers by a point and a half on the road; the market by 2.5, and the blend keeps Pittsburgh a Lean.
games.2026_04_IND_WAS: The first London game of the season, with Washington the designated home team but no home-field edge for either side and the international variance added. Indianapolis beat Houston with a 53-yard walk-off kick and rates slightly below average; Alec Pierce is on IR and the kicker, Spencer Shrader, is questionable. Washington beat Seattle with Marcus Mariota and gets Mariota again unless Jayden Daniels, traveling and practicing in some form, is cleared; the Commanders remain without Tunsil, Newton and Amos, with Cosmi and Nick Cross doubtful. The model has the Colts by six; the market says 3.5.
games.2026_04_ARI_NYG: Two bottom-ten teams. The Giants lost Brian Burns for the season with a torn ACL and placed Paulson Adebo on IR, with Deonte Banks and Tyler Nubin questionable; Jameis Winston stays the starter after beating Tennessee, with J.J. McCarthy newly acquired. Arizona is without Will Johnson (IR) and James Conner and has Taylor-Demerson questionable. Both sides carry a rating near minus four after adjustments; the market has Arizona by 1.5, the model by one, and the blend makes the Cardinals a coin-flip road pick.
games.2026_04_DAL_HOU: Houston is 0-3 and its rating has fallen from fifth to below average, but Dallas is worse off: safeties Jalen Thompson, Malik Hooker and P.J. Locke are all out or doubtful, Cobie Durant is out, Overshown is doubtful, and Tyler Smith is on IR. Nico Collins has a decent chance to return for Houston, with Ed Ingram questionable and Clowney doubtful. Roof closed. The model has the Texans by four and a half at home; the market by 2.5.
games.2026_04_GB_TB: The one game where the data and the market pick different teams. Tampa Bay is 0-3 and just lost Baker Mayfield (dislocated throwing thumb) for at least three weeks; undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts, a three-and-a-half-point downgrade, with Jalen McMillan doubtful and Wirfs probable. But Green Bay has collapsed: its rating has dropped four and a half points on three games, Jayden Reed and Bako-Bewele joined Parsons and Jacobs on the shelf, and Edgerrin Cooper and Aaron Banks are questionable. Green Bay does get three extra days of rest after Thursday's loss. The model has this a pick; the market has the Packers by 3.5, and the blend makes Green Bay a coin-flip pick.
games.2026_04_JAX_CIN: Jacksonville is the second-rated team in the model after routing New England and is close to full strength. Cincinnati lost a shootout in Pittsburgh but gets the full Burrow adjustment, the biggest quarterback boost on the slate, at home; Andrei Iosivas is on IR, B.J. Hill is doubtful, and Bryan Cook and Kyle Dugger are questionable. The model has the Jaguars by four on the road; the market has the Bengals by 2.5, and the blend makes Jacksonville the narrowest of coin-flip picks.
games.2026_04_LA_PHI: The Rams rate fourth despite the Denver loss but keep losing bodies: Myles Garrett is on IR, Puka Nacua is questionable for a third week, Terrance Ferguson and Jaylen Watson are out. Philadelphia is 2-1 with a rating that has fallen three points on three ugly games, without Goedert and Dickerson and with Hollywood Brown questionable; Greenard is back. Rain through the afternoon at the Linc compresses the margin. The model has the Rams by five on the road; the market by three.
games.2026_04_NE_BUF: Buffalo is 3-0 and rated fifth; Josh Allen took a knee hit in the fourth quarter but is expected to play, DJ Moore and Ed Oliver are back, and Christian Benford is doubtful in a walking boot. New England is 1-2 with seven Maye turnovers, A.J. Brown and Mike Onwenu on IR, and Van Roten, Barmore, Dre'Mont Jones and Woodson questionable. Model and market agree on Bills by about seven.
games.2026_04_NYJ_CHI: Chicago beat Philadelphia with Case Keenum and its rating is seventh in the league, but the quarterback is still a backup: Caleb Williams is out three to four weeks, and Ben Johnson has not chosen between Keenum and a cleared Tyson Bagent. Braxton Jones is doubtful at left tackle. The Jets are the fourth-lowest-rated team and lose Breece Hall (doubtful) and guard Dylan Parham, with Fitzpatrick, Mason Taylor and Omar Cooper still in doubt. The model has the Bears by nine; the market's 3.5 pulls the blend to six and a half.
games.2026_04_TEN_BAL: Baltimore beat Dallas on a 56-yard walk-off in Rio but lost both centers, with rookie Vega Ioane moving to center; Stanley and Mark Andrews are questionable, Flowers and Madubuike are back. Tennessee is 0-3, rated second-worst, and lost two guards (Carmona out, Slater doubtful). Rain and gusts in Baltimore. The model has the Ravens by ten and a half; the market by 11.5.
games.2026_04_MIA_MIN: The widest gap of the week. Minnesota is 3-0 with the league's best defense so far and gets Kyler Murray back, though Justin Jefferson (ankle sprain) is questionable and could be rested. Miami is 0-3, rated last, and lost De'Von Achane for the season with a torn ACL, with Kenneth Grant still on IR. Dome. The model has the Vikings by 13; the market by 11.5, and the simulation gives Miami about one chance in six.
games.2026_04_DEN_SF: San Francisco is 3-0 and rated third but is running out of bodies: Nick Bosa is out with a calf, three receivers are on IR with Demarcus Robinson also out, Mike Evans and Trent Williams are questionable. Denver's rating has slipped after two narrow games but the Broncos are relatively healthy apart from Jonah Coleman on IR and Marvin Mims questionable. Model and market both have the 49ers by about three.
games.2026_04_KC_LV: Kansas City is 3-0, rated sixth, and healthy apart from Josh Simmons at left tackle. Las Vegas is 3-0 too and its rating has climbed more than four points on the season, with Brock Bowers back and producing, though Jack Bech is on IR and Powers-Johnson is questionable. Cousins grades as an upgrade on last year's Raiders quarterback play. Dome. The model has the Chiefs by under four; the market says 4.5.
games.2026_04_LAC_SEA: The largest disagreement with the market on the slate. Seattle is the top-rated team, Sam Darnold is back after throwing for 379 and four touchdowns in Washington, and Lumen Field is the strongest home edge in the league. The Chargers are 0-3 in Jim Harbaugh's first such start, with Njoku, Kolar, Pipkins and Biadasz all on IR, Awosika out, Donte Jackson doubtful, and Tomlinson and Molden questionable. The model has the Seahawks by 17; the market's seven pulls the blend to twelve and a half, and Seattle is the strongest pick of the week.
games.2026_04_DET_CAR: Detroit is 2-1 with Branch and Joseph still out and now Avonte Maddox and Thomas Harper on IR, but Mahogany and Miller are back on the line. Carolina's rating has fallen back after losing in Cleveland, and the injury list is the worst on the slate: Jaycee Horn (torn quad) and Mike Jackson are out at corner, Damien Lewis is out at guard, Ekwonu and Moton remain out, and Bryce Young has lower-body soreness though Canales expects him to play. Storms possible Sunday night. The model has the Lions by nearly five; the market by 3.5.
games.2026_04_ATL_NO: Atlanta's rating recovered somewhat after Penix's win at Lambeau in his return, but A.J. Terrell joined Jalon Walker on IR and James Pearce Jr. is still suspended, a five-point injury hit. New Orleans lost Kelvin Banks to IR and Travis Etienne for this game, though Kamara carries the backfield and Shough has been productive despite six giveaways. Atlanta has eleven days of rest to New Orleans' eight. Superdome. The model has the Saints by four; the market by three.
